about: The stack machine's mutants: the verifier (vm.Verify) and the loop that runs only verified programs (vm.Exec). Killers are the examples suite (examples:stackvm: its tests and laws, ExecAgreesWithChecked above all, and its cases); each rule names the law or test that kills it.

mutants.name: svm-verify-need-dropped
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked and FuelBoundsSteps: Verify admits an instruction that finds one value fewer than it pops (Joined(0)'s Print at depth 0, or a Bent near miss), and Exec reads a value where Checked traps on Underflow.

mutants.name: svm-verify-merge-depth-ignored
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked: Joined(0), whose two paths meet at its Print with depths 0 and 1, is admitted, and its jump path prints a value where Checked traps on Underflow.

mutants.name: svm-verify-room-halved
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked: Tower(60) gets a stack of 32 under a proved depth of 60, its pushes wrap onto the bottom, and its sum differs from Checked's. (for room < bound is an equivalent mutant: a depth of bound uses indices below bound.)

mutants.name: svm-verify-room-ignores-frames
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked: Down(9000), whose frames each keep a value, outgrows a room sized for two frames: its values run into its return points, and it ends otherwise than on Checked.

mutants.name: svm-verify-callee-need-dropped
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked: Short, which calls an Add with one value on the stack, is admitted, and Exec adds a value where Checked traps on Underflow.

mutants.name: svm-verify-ret-depth-ignored
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked: Uneven(0), whose subroutine returns with one value less on one path, is admitted, and its Print reads a value where Checked traps on Underflow.

mutants.name: svm-verify-ret-in-main
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked: Unopened, a Ret with no call open, is admitted; with 5 fuel Exec returns to 0 and runs out where Checked traps on NoFrame.

mutants.name: svm-exec-mask-narrow
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked: Tower(60) pushes past 32 values on execFlat, the push wraps onto the bottom, and the printed sum differs from Checked's.

mutants.name: svm-exec-calls-mask-narrow
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked: under half the mask Down(9000)'s return points start in the middle of the room and meet its values, so it ends otherwise than on Checked.

mutants.name: svm-exec-resume-drops-printed
mutants.from: return try resume(code, fuel, paused{stack: held(stack[0:64], sp), frames: []int{}, printed: printed,
mutants.to: return try resume(code, fuel, paused{stack: held(stack[0:64], sp), frames: []int{}, printed: []int{},
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked: Printing(k), given exactly the fuel to halt, leaves execFlat at its last backward JumpIf and, with this mutant, halts in the checked loop without the values it printed.

mutants.name: svm-exec-low-ignored
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked: Down(k) with one step less than it needs runs low on fuel at a Ret; with this mutant execCalls leaves its loop unmarked and returns a Result there instead of going on to the OutOfFuel trap on the checked loop.

mutants.name: svm-exec-ret-skips-fuel
mutants.from:
pc = mem[(top-fp)&top]
			if pc <= at && left <= end {
mutants.rule: ExecAgreesWithChecked: Down(k) unwinds by backward Rets only; with a fuel that runs out while it unwinds, Exec halts where Checked traps on OutOfFuel.

mutants.name: svm-exec-call-depth-unchecked
mutants.rule: TrapsAreTyped: Call{To: 0} calls itself until its fuel runs out, where Checked traps on TooDeep at the 10001st call.
